question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 2.
solution: The correct answer is '**acute**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence '*many years have been a problem for the zoologists and other specialists; but more recently the problem has become so (2) *______,' requires most appropriate word for the given **blank number 2.** • **The **marked option** 'acute' **means very serious; very great (बहुत गंभीर; बहुत अधिक.) • *** Example**:He suffers from **acute **depression. * • *​*In this particular sentence, **acute** symbolizes that the problem has become **severe as **it has been for many years. • Hence,the correct answer is **option 1.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • ** **steep: (used about a hill, mountain, street, etc.) rising or falling quickly; at a sharp angle **(पहाड़ी, पहाड़, सड़क आदि) बहुत अधिक चढ़ाव या उतार वाला; लगभग लंब के समान सीधा खड़ा** • narrow: having only a short distance from side to side **तंग, संकीर्ण** • rare: not done, seen, happening, etc. very often **दुर्लभ, विरल (बहुत कम किया जाने, दीखने या होने वाला)** 43:T632, The correct answer is concerned'.
